description:
Budget 2021: The government will introduce the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) IPO in financial year 2022. "We would also bring the IPO of LIC in 2021-22, for which I am bringing the requisite amendments in this session itself, the Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said in the course of her Budget speech.
